verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own deletion capability: an API to suppress and delete user data, plus a compliance workflow that pushes deletion requests to the whole downstream stack. The retention half of the story is not evidenced; no retention-period or data-expiry controls are documented, and storing data on your own infrastructure is a residency control, not retention. missing for 10: configurable data retention periods/expiry controls, detailed deletion API docs (scope, timelines, confirmation), independent or hands-on corroboration of deletion working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Suppress and delete user data in accordance with your user suppression policies
When users update preferences or request to be deleted, push the change to your entire stack from one centralized platform.
